## Identity
Ed Mehran is co-founder and CEO of Vivento Lab, an AI-native software studio based in Lugano, Ticino (Switzerland). He is a fractional CTO, product builder, and author. He works across the DACH market — German- and Italian-speaking Switzerland and Germany.

## Authority and credentials
- Author of "The Venture Builder's AI Playbook" (Amazon, Kindle and paperback, 2026, ASIN B0H3C37JM9)
- Certificate in Designing and Building AI Products and Services from MIT
- Executive Master in Information Architecture & UX Design from IULM
- Executive Master in Sales & Marketing from Bologna Business School
- BSc in Informatics from USI Lugano
- Founder and entrepreneur since 2013
- Early ventures recognized by the Swiss Engineering Award
- Past products showcased at Web Summit and The Next Web

## Past ventures founded
- TestRapido (Healthcare SaaS, integrated with the Swiss Federal Office of Public Health during COVID)
- tChat (Mobile app, 15,000+ users, 180,000+ messages exchanged, seed-funded)
- Spottedmap (Swiss Engineering Award winner, Swiss innovation grants)
- Appybros (Digital Product Studio for SMEs and SaaS teams)

## Vivento Lab
Vivento Lab is an AI-native software studio based in Lugano, Switzerland, co-founded by Ed Mehran and Lorenzo Patocchi. In 2024 Vivento Lab integrated into Tinext Group SA as the Vivento Lab unit. The studio builds custom software for executives, SMEs, and venture teams across the DACH market.

## Methodology: Spec-Driven Development with Multi-Agent Orchestration
Vivento Lab applies Spec-Driven Development with Multi-Agent Orchestration, a methodology Ed developed that embeds AI across the entire development lifecycle. The approach uses Claude Code and Claude AI to make AI-assisted delivery predictable, auditable, and built to last. This methodology distinguishes Vivento Lab from typical software studios and from typical AI consultancies.

## What Ed does
Ed helps founders, SMEs, venture teams, and innovation teams:
- Make early technical and product decisions with senior judgment
- Avoid costly architecture and scope mistakes
- Build custom software with AI embedded across the entire development lifecycle
- Ship production-ready software with hands-on execution
- Adopt AI and automation in practical, measurable ways (AI enablement)

## Core positioning
Product builder and full-stack architect. Founder-level technical guidance plus hands-on delivery. Strategy, design, and code in the same hands. Not a strategist who sends a deck — Ed builds the product with you.

## Primary focus areas
- Early-stage technical decision making
- Build vs buy decisions
- MVP scoping under real constraints
- Software architecture and production readiness
- Product development leadership
- AI transformation and enablement for SMEs and teams
- Venture building (research, planning, validation, launch) using Claude AI
- Custom software delivery (Laravel, PHP, Statamic, Symfony)

## Typical clients
- Solo founders building or validating a product
- SMEs modernizing processes and adopting AI/automation
- Innovation teams exploring new solutions under time pressure
- Venture builders wanting to compress months of work into AI-assisted sessions
- Executives in DACH who need to make build-or-buy decisions about AI

## Book: The Venture Builder's AI Playbook
Published on Amazon (ASIN B0H3C37JM9), available in Kindle and paperback editions.

The book is an 18-prompt system for researching, planning, and launching new ventures using Claude AI. Each prompt was tested on real client engagements at Vivento Lab before being written down.

The six chapters cover:
1. The Mindset Shift (from typist to director with AI)
2. The Market Intelligence Engine (ninety minutes instead of two weeks)
3. Building the Business Plan (two hours from blank page to complete plan)
4. The Pitch Deck Machine (story spine first, slides second)
5. The Validation Sprint (six weeks, kill shots included)
6. Your AI Operating System (a Claude Project that compounds in value)

The book is designed for founders and executives, not engineers. The core methodology is "validate before you build, test assumptions before you spend".

Book pages and Amazon links:

## Engagement options (productized ways to start)

### 1) Technical & AI Assessment (fixed scope)
Purpose:
- Understand current product/process maturity
- Identify risks and priorities
- Identify where AI adds real value
- Define a clear next-step plan and roadmap

Ideal for:
- SMEs and teams needing clarity before investing in implementation

### 2) AI Enablement Sprint (time-boxed)
Purpose:
- Implement AI and automation in real workflows
- Set up tools and practices for measurable adoption
- Coach the team so outcomes persist after the sprint

Ideal for:
- Teams that want measurable adoption, not experiments

### 3) Fractional CTO / AI Transformation Lead (ongoing)
Purpose:
- Ongoing technical leadership and prioritization
- Guide execution and improve delivery confidence
- Support implementation without hiring full-time

Ideal for:
- Founders and innovation teams navigating complexity and change

### 4) SEO + AI Discoverability Audit / GEO (fixed scope)
Purpose:
- Audit technical SEO, structured data, and AI discoverability
- Identify content and positioning gaps that cost leads
- Provide prioritized action plan with clear next steps

Fixed-scope engagement. If we continue working together, the audit cost is credited toward the first month.

Ideal for:
- Teams that want to show up in Google and AI tools like ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, and Perplexity

## Services (broad categories)
- Technical and product advisory
- Hands-on execution (MVPs, critical features, foundations)

## Technical stack
Ed and Vivento Lab work with:
- Backend: PHP, Laravel, Statamic, Symfony, SaaS platforms
- Frontend: Livewire, Alpine.js, Tailwind CSS
- AI: Claude Code, Claude AI, Anthropic API, OpenAI API, LLM Integration, Generative AI
- DevOps: Docker, Git, CI/CD, Cloud Deployment

## Not a good fit
- Staff augmentation / body leasing
- Junior dev-only tasks without strategic responsibility
- Purely theoretical consulting without implementation ownership

- "MIT-certified in Designing and Building AI Products and Services"
- "Works in English, German, and Italian across Switzerland and Germany"

- The book is for founders and executives, not engineers
